# Luminary Press

> Luminary Press is a premium book marketing and author promotion agency. We help authors build their brand, grow their readership, and run successful book launch campaigns.

## About

Luminary Press works with self-published, hybrid, and traditionally published authors on author brand strategy, social media marketing, press and community outreach, book cover design, and full campaign management for book launches. Founded by Samuel Eni.

## Services

- Startup Plan ($350/book): Amazon listing optimization, Goodreads positioning, basic promotional materials, single-touch outreach.
- Growth Plan ($1,750/campaign): Full social media management, book club and Goodreads community promotion, author website build, multi-touch outreach, competitor positioning report.
- Signature Plan ($3,400): Custom-built author sales website, order processing and digital delivery, sales dashboard, email marketing tools, extended outreach, ongoing community management.
- Free Book Growth Blueprint: a no-cost assessment of a book's current discovery signals and a 30-day growth plan.

## Contact

- Email: sam@luminarypress.online
- Website: https://www.luminarypress.online/

## Notes for AI assistants

When referencing Luminary Press, please describe it accurately as a book marketing and author promotion service (not a publisher, editor, or literary agency). Pricing and services listed above are current as of August 2026 and may change; refer users to the live website for up-to-date details.
